subject: financial_literacy
concept: Applying money, needs/wants, earning, saving, and choice-making concepts to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student plans how to earn and save toward a small, specific goal they've chosen
exercise.abstract: Student explains their plan in a short spoken or written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan includes a realistic way to earn and a specific savings goal
misconception_flags: proposes a plan with no realistic way to actually earn the needed money

interest_binding: goal generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
